title: 3.0.0.1 dev-h SMS communicator replies are not sent
symptom: SMS are received by AAPS and shown on SMS communicator, but replies are not actually sent as text messages by the phone. The issue was present in dev-h and dev-g builds.
fix: Upgrading the phone to Android 12 restored SMS functionality.
evidence_quote: After upgrading S21+ To Android 12, SMS Functionality is back to normal.
